newsitem.title: UK: T&N to shift asbestos costs off P&L account.
newsitem.headline: T&N to shift asbestos costs off P&L account.

text.p: British components group T&N Plc said on Wednesday that the costs of the fighting fund it was to set up in tandem with its new asbestos liability insurance package would end the annual charge to its profit and loss account and unlock value for shareholders.

This year's profit and loss account will be charged a total of 465 million stg, to include the 92 million stg insurance premium, which will cut group reserves to 135 million stg from 574 million stg as reported in 1995.

"Subject to shareholder and court approval, the nominal value of the company's shares will be reduced to offset the deficit on the company's reserves...so that dividends can continue to be paid," the company explained in a statement.
Chairman Sir Colin Hope told Reuters this legal measure was in essence a technicality that should not hit shareholders in any way.
